futures.why_could_matter: If improvements to transparent editorial policies are empirically tracked, Mexican journals may increase interoperability and trust.
futures.uncertainty: Only six journals and public web documents; evidence of posted policies does not verify internal editorial practice.
futures.research_question: Which transparency and preservation policy changes at Mexican scientific journals lead to verifiable gains in research accessibility and trust?

aboutness.basis: Workshop presentation explicitly includes UAE institutional persistent-identifier use cases alongside Tunisia and Morocco.
aboutness.verified_excerpt: Zenodo describes a DataCite talk presenting UAE, Tunisian and Moroccan DOI/metadata use cases.

topic.label: Open science
topic.basis: Open science infrastructure, DOI metadata and research interoperability are direct topics.

futures.mechanism: DataCite persistent identifiers and metadata services could improve discoverability and interoperability of UAE research data.
futures.why_could_matter: If reported institutional use cases are independently documented, persistent-ID infrastructure could support additional open science coordination.
futures.uncertainty: Presentation is not peer-reviewed empirical research; actual institutional rollout and benefits not independently confirmed.

source_verification.basis: Springer Nature BMC Medical Education article accessible in full at PMC with DOI, survey methods, 230 respondents and detailed breakdown of career challenges.

aboutness.basis: National U.S. survey sample and regional comparisons focus on American early-career physician-scientists.
aboutness.verified_excerpt: Original article reports 230 respondents; 49% had considered leaving their research career within the next two years.

topic.label: Research careers
topic.basis: Explicit research-career retention, funding, protected research time and academic workforce development.

futures.mechanism: Physician-scientist training, career grants and protected research time affect translational research workforce capacity.
futures.why_could_matter: If support measures are experimentally or longitudinally assessed, institutions may improve retention of U.S. physician-scientists.
futures.uncertainty: Cross-sectional voluntary survey with selection bias; intention to leave is not observed attrition.
futures.research_question: Which mentorship and protected-time policies measurably improve retention among U.S. early-career physician-scientists?

aboutness.verified_excerpt: Independent 2014 research mapping report cites the South African data stewardship work as an October 2010 CODATA contribution.

topic.label: Research data

futures.mechanism: South African data curation and social-science repository practices.
